items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Theodore Ross was playing lead alto. And Lester Young and all of them were there in Sioux City at that time.

ctx.x: Of course, I knew Walter Paige before because when I was in Sioux City, Iowa, stationed there with Grant Moore, the Blue Devils were stationed there, too. They were playing in Sioux City and they had Lester Young and Buster Smith and
Theodore Ross was playing lead alto. And Lester Young and all of them were there in Sioux City at that time.

So anyway, we went back to Kansas City and we started rehearsing this new band. And we stayed around there a while. Finally we took another trip back out East. And we were stranded all over the United States. Everywhere this band -- we had a lot of fun but we never really made any money. We were stranded everyplace. We played --
